## Framing principles (Alex Hormozi "AI in Business" content, 2026-04-23)

When drafting promo doc / talent review:

1. **"Cloud-to-dirt" knowledge integration.** William owns the full stack: strategy + operational judgment + system knowledge + execution. The GenAI suite exists because one person owned all four. Promo case = "I codified judgment that no siloed function could have encoded," not "I used AI."
2. **"Apples-to-apples" comparison.** Compare AI workflow at "6 months in" vs human flash narrative at "6 months in," not v1 AI vs mature human process.
3. **"Outcomes, not tools."** Lead with hours saved (407 hrs/yr individual capacity, 224 hrs/yr team scaling), not "I used Kiro."
4. **"Pattern recognition, not magic."** Codified judgment compounds — every encoded pattern = one less recurring decision.
